text:
Priya N: Heads up 11 a small POC with BetaHealth asking for a temporary hosted per-token discount for months 1-2 to validate performance of our embeddings pipeline. Can deal desk greenlight?
Ben R: what's the ask?
Priya N: They want $0.0005/token for first 2 months (standard is $0.0009). Expected ~5M tokens/mo during POC. They also asked for no minimum in month 1 and a $1k min in month 2.
Liliana M: we need to consider administrative overhead. Suggest converting to a promo credit applied post-invoice vs changing live rates to avoid billing mess.
Priya N: AE says they prefer rate override on invoice so their procurement sees unit price, but ok with promo credit if that's easier.
Ben R: Finance note: promo credit is easier to audit. If we do a rate override, we need a formal exception record and the discount code on the invoice. Deal desk needs delta amount and why exception is strategic.
Priya N: delta = (0.0009-0.0005)*10M = $4k over two months. Reason: strategic healthcare customer, expected enterprise rollout to Dedicated in 6-9 months.
FinanceBot: Please submit exception via template: ```{
"customer":"BetaHealth",
"override_rate":"0.0005",
"duration_months":"2",
"expected_tokens_total":"10000000",
"min_charges":"0/1000"
}```
Liliana M: engineering ops request: Set soft alarm at 4M tokens/month and hard cap at 6M tokens/month. Also require AE to confirm test accounts are flagged so traffic doesn't look like prod.
Ben R: agree to caps. We'll also add a 15% buffer for any distribution variance when recording expected discount.
Deal Desk: Conditioned approval: (1) Signed SOW or PO that references the temporary pricing or (2) AE confirms promo-credit workflow and attaches internal ticket. (3) Add usage alerts to #sales-usage and cc eng-oncall. (4) Cap=6M/month hard, soft alert 4M/month. Valid for months 1-2 only.
Priya N: I'll get SOW updated to include the temporary pricing line item. If procurement won't sign fast enough, we can fall back to promo credit.
Ben R: I'll create the finance ticket to reserve the promo credit code and hold until SOW/PO uploaded.
Liliana M: I'll reach out to infra for the alert and to tag eng-oncall.
Priya N: tagging @Deal Desk for final note 1: please add approval to the CLM after we upload SOW.
Deal Desk: Will do. Approved pending documentation. :white_check_mark:
